title: Name your school and work through setup

steps.say: First-time setup is four short steps, listed down the left — your school, your staff, your courses, your classes. Tap any of them to jump straight to it, forwards or back.
Type your school's name as you would write it on a letterhead — this is what your teachers and students see on every page and every invite link.

**Save & exit** saves the step you're on and puts you back on your dashboard, so you never have to finish setup in one sitting. Come back to Settings and First-time setup whenever you want to carry on.
steps.terminal: Everything the wizard sets up can also be changed later from Settings and from your class pages — nothing here is a one-shot.
